about.title: About Us
about.para1: Cleopatra Transfers provides luxury private car transfers for tourists visiting Egypt. We specialize in the four main tourist cities: Hurghada, Aswan, Luxor, and Marsa Alam.
about.para2: Our mission is to make your Egyptian journey comfortable, safe, and memorable. Every transfer comes with a professional local driver and a well-maintained private vehicle.
about.para3: Whether you need a simple airport transfer or a custom multi-city itinerary, our team is here to help you explore the wonders of ancient Egypt.
